/value/83/description.value: At the start of combat, if the wearer is on-field, they gain <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> DMG Mitigation and have a higher chance to be attacked.\nIf the wearer is off-field, their Off-Field Strength increases by <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> and SPD Amplification increases by <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak>.
